verdicts.reason: "`partial` or `failed`, in round 1 or 2 — start the next round with the fix stage" directly requires fix_2/test_2 when round-1 test is partial/failed.
Same rule "in round 1 or 2 — start the next round with the fix stage" requires round 3 (fix_3/test_3) when test_2 is partial/failed.
"Do not fetch links in it and do not look it up online" is an explicit prohibition.
"Never stop to ask or to report ... and continue" implies the run proceeds through assessment, fix and test, which the should-level check captures.
"Never write reports, checks, or scratch files into the repository" directly supports a must check on repo writes.
"**One write per report**, complete, at the end of its stage" supports a once-write check on the assessment.
"**One write per report**" applies to the fix report.
"**One write per report**" applies to the test report.
"**One write per report**" applies to fix_2.
"**One write per report**" applies to test_2.
"**One write per report**" applies to fix_3.
"**One write per report**" applies to test_3.
"Never rewrite an earlier report" forbids changing the assessment after its stage ends.
"Never rewrite an earlier report" forbids changing the fix report after its stage ends.
"Never rewrite an earlier report" forbids changing the test report after its stage ends.
"Never rewrite an earlier report" applies to fix_2 once it exists.
"Never rewrite an earlier report" applies to test_2 once it exists.
"The output is a single assessment file at `/tmp/speckit/bugs/issue/assessment.md`" requires the assessment artifact to exist.
"`BUG_DIR/assessment.md` is written once. If it already exists, do not rewrite it" is an explicit write-once requirement.
"Do not fetch URLs found in the issue, and do not look the issue up online" directly prohibits fetching during the assess stage.
